info.title: FinStack API
info.description:
Production-minded fintech backend starter: wallets, double-entry ledger, payments, webhooks, idempotency and reconciliation.

**Money** is always an integer in minor units (e.g. kobo, cents) paired with an ISO 4217 currency code.

**Errors** use [RFC 9457 Problem Details](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9457) (`application/problem+json`). Branch on the stable `code` field, not on `detail`.

**Request IDs**: send `X-Request-Id` to correlate calls; one is generated if absent and always echoed in the response.

tags.name: Wallets
tags.description: Multi-currency wallets backed by the double-entry ledger

tags.name: Transactions
tags.description: Transfers and transaction history (money-moving calls need an Idempotency-Key)

tags.name: Payments
tags.description: Incoming payments via providers, with FX into the primary wallet

tags.name: FX
tags.description: Exchange rates and locked conversion quotes

tags.name: Admin
tags.description: Operations: webhook events, replay, queue health (admin role)

type.description: Problem type URI. `about:blank` when the HTTP status says it all.

code.description: Stable, machine-readable error code for client logic

requestId.description: Correlates the error with server logs (`X-Request-Id`)

code.description: Stable, machine-readable error code for client logic

role.description: Your role in this organization (null when calling with an API key)

permissions.description: What you may do: your role's permissions, or the API key's scopes

userId.description: An existing member who becomes the owner

password.description: 12–128 characters. Long passphrases are encouraged; there are no composition rules (NIST SP 800-63B).

Refresh token from a previous login or refresh

scopes.description: What the key may do; keys cannot manage members, keys or the organization

expiresAt.description: Optional expiry (must be in the future)

key.description: The secret key. Shown ONCE; store it securely. Send it as the X-API-Key header.

currency.description: Currency of the wallet. Defaults to DEFAULT_WALLET_CURRENCY (USD); must be in ALLOWED_WALLET_CURRENCIES. Cannot be changed later.

available.description: Spendable balance in minor units (e.g. cents)

pending.description: Incoming funds not yet settled, in minor units

reserved.description: Funds on hold, in minor units

isPrimary.description: The primary wallet receives payments in currencies the user has no wallet for, after FX conversion.

transactionId.description: Ledger transaction this entry belongs to

type.description: `credit` adds to the wallet, `debit` takes from it

nextCursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to get the next (older) page. `null` on the last page.

rate.description: Units of `quote` per 1 `base`, as a decimal string (up to 10 decimal places). Strings avoid floating-point rounding.

sourceAmount.description: Amount to pay, in source minor units. Provide exactly one of `sourceAmount` or `targetAmount`.

targetAmount.description: Amount to receive, in target minor units.

sourceAmount.description: Amount charged, in source minor units

targetAmount.description: Amount credited after the spread, in target minor units

rate.description: Mid rate used: units of `rateQuote` per 1 `rateBase`

amount.description: Amount in minor units of the currency (e.g. cents)

currency.description: Defaults to the currency of your primary wallet

fee.description: Fee charged, if any (added for transfers/payouts, deducted for payments)

organizationId.description: An organization's own rate; omit for the platform default

maxAmount.description: Minor units; omit for no cap

total.description: Payouts and transfers: what leaves the wallet (amount + fee). Payments: what the wallet receives (amount - fee).

daily.description: Rolling 24 hours: limits, used and remaining (null = unlimited)

organizationId.description: An organization's own limits; omit for the platform default

maxPerTransaction.description: Minor units; omit for no cap

amount.description: Amount the wallet receives, in its minor units

quoteExpiresAt.description: Pay before this to get this amount; later payments are re-quoted.

conversion.description: Present when the payment is converted into the wallet currency

fee.description: Taken from what the wallet receives, in the wallet's currency; null when free

heldAmount.description: Still in the wallet's pending balance from this payment (wallet currency, minor units)

nextCursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; null on the last page

amount.description: Amount to charge, in minor units of `currency`

currency.description: Currency to charge. If you have no wallet in it, the payment is converted into your primary wallet at a locked quote.

callbackUrl.description: Where the provider sends the customer after checkout

callbackUrl.description: Where the provider sends the customer after checkout

customerEmail.description: The paying customer's email, passed to the provider's checkout

amount.description: Amount to return to the customer, in minor units of the PAYMENT currency. Omit to refund everything still refundable.
Minor units of the wallet currency
Returned to the customer, payment currency minor units

failureReason.description: Why it failed, including the provider's own message

amount.description: Amount to send, in minor units of the wallet's currency

fee.description: Added on top of the amount; null when free
